contract_term.value: Initial term of at least 15 years from the initial service date, starting after a negotiated ramp-up period of up to 5 years; then automatic 5-year extensions unless the customer gives 4 years' written notice. cites.quote: A Large Load Customer must agree to a rate contract term for an initial period of a minimum of fifteen (15) years from the initial service date for billing purposes. The minimum contract term shall commence after a negotiated ramp-up period not exceeding five (5) years, as determined by the Company.

At the conclusion of the initial contract term, the contract shall automatically renew in five-year contract extensions unless the Large Load Customer provides four (4) years advance written notice of the intention to terminate the contract.

The Company reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to allow a one-time reduction, not to exceed 10% of Contracted Capacity, to the Contract Capacity if requested by the Large Load Customer. A minimum of 48 months advance written notice must be provided for the requested reduction.
